维度: 4.合并/修改代码（代码级传染性）
原文: All distribution of Covered Software in Source Code Form, including any Modifications... must be under the terms of this License. ... You may create and distribute a Larger Work under terms of Your choice, provided that You also comply with the requirements of this License for the Covered Software.
解释: 允许修改和合并代码，但修改后的文件必须按MPL分发；独立文件组合成Larger Work时，Larger Work整体可按自有条款分发，故为文件级传染，不强制整个作品使用相同许可证。

原文: "Larger Work" means a work that combines Covered Software with other material, in a separate file or files, that is not Covered Software. ... You may create and distribute a Larger Work under terms of Your choice...
解释: 许可证没有明确提及静态/动态链接。其文件级copyleft机制意味着组合到独立文件中的其他代码不自动传染，但可执行形式的分发仍需提供MPL源码。链接是否构成“单独文件”或“包含Covered Software的新文件”存在解释空间，故模糊。
